description: Produce an e-invoice as `ubl` or `cii` XML or a ZUGFeRD hybrid PDF (`zugferd`) from invoice data: an XRechnung for a public-sector buyer (profile `xrechnung`, the default), a plain EN 16931 invoice for a business (profile `en16931`). Totals are computed server-side in decimal arithmetic, and the document is validated against the official rules before it is returned. Data the rules do not permit is refused with the broken rules and how to fix each. Needs the user's NormAPI account; each document counts against the monthly allowance (50 free).

percent.description: Give amount or percent, exactly one.
